policy: Owner decision D-4 (REQUIREMENTS §67, 2026-10-12): every APK actually delivered to the owner gets a strictly larger versionCode than every earlier delivery, keeps applicationId and the original signing certificate, and is recorded here with its source commit, APK SHA-256 and certificate SHA-256. Append-only; checked by scripts/delivery_ledger.py. Development commits that are never delivered do not bump versionCode. Private download links, keys and passwords never go here.

pre_policy.note: Before D-4, several different privately delivered APKs (2026-10-09 to 2026-10-12, e.g. APK 6cda8775…, 2a34afa0…, d9d874e8…) all used versionCode 25 / versionName 0.2.0, so the installed build cannot be told apart by version alone. The public GitHub Release v0.2.0 (2026-10-06) used versionCode 5. Their source and APK hashes stay in the cited records; they are not copied here.
